question: Babur, the first Mughal emperor (1526-1530), succeeded to the throne of Ferghana in 1494 when he was only _______ old.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Babur**__

__
 
• Babur was born in 1483 in Andijan, which is now Uzbekistan.
 
• His father was the ruler of the small kingdom of Ferghana in Central Asia.
 
• When Babur was 12 years old, his father died, and he became the ruler of Ferghana.
 
• However, he was soon driven out of his kingdom by his enemies, and he spent the next few years wandering in Central Asia and trying to regain his throne.
 
• **Babur finally succeeded in regaining Ferghana in 1494 when he was 12 years old**.
 
• This was the beginning of his long and eventful career as a military leader and ruler, which eventually led him to conquer much of South Asia and establish the Mughal Empire.

• **Some other important Mughal Emperor**
 
• **Humayun__:**
 __
 
• Humayun was the **eldest son of Babur**.
 
• In the Battle of **Chausa**, **1539 **and Battle of** Bilgram**,** 1540** (**Battle of Kanauj**), Humayun was** defeated** by **Sher Khan**.
 
• After losing his kingdom, Humayun became an exile for the next **15 years**.
 
• **In 1555**, Humayun defeated the Afghans and recovered the Mughal Throne.
 
• He died in **1556** due to his fall from the **staircase of his library**.
 
 
 
• **Akbar__:**
 __
 
• ​Akbar was one of the **mightiest emperors **during the Mughal Era.
 
• He was the **son** of Mughal emperor **Humayun** and **Hamida Banu Begum**.
 
• Akbar was** born** in** October 1542** and** died** on** 27th October 1605**.
 
• He was the** third Mughal Emperor**.
 
• His reign was between **1556-1605 AD**.
 
• He was crowned in **1556**, at the young age of **thirteen years**.
 
• He was assisted by** Barram Khan**.
 
• Akbar's tomb is located in** Sikandra Agra**.
 
• Its construction was started by Akbar in **1605 **and completed by **Jahangir**.
 
• It is a beautiful** five-story tomb**.
 
 
 
• ​__**__Aurangzeb__:**
 
 
• ​Aurangzeb was the** son** of **Shah Jahan**.
 
• The original name of Aurangzeb was** Muhi-ud-Din Muhammad**.
 
• He adopted the title of '**Alamgir**' which means '**conqueror of the world**'.
 
• He was the **sixth Mughal emperor**, who ruled over almost the entire Indian subcontinent for a period of **49 years**.
 
• He was **died** on** 1707**.
